name: Posedge
description: Offline-first project + learning tracker with week planning and spaced repetition. No backend, installs as a PWA

paragraphs: Posedge is a personal, browser-only project and learning tracker built for VJ (MS ECE @ USC). Plan color-coded projects week by week, see progress at a glance, and lock in what you study with built-in spaced repetition. There is no backend and no login: everything lives in your browser (IndexedDB), with JSON export/import. It installs as a PWA and works offline.

features: Today: daily ring, reviews due, today's tasks by project, Big 3, overdue tasks, Done today.
Week: backlog + unplanned + 7 day columns with capacity bars; drag with mouse, touch or keyboard.
Projects: Kanban board (with a job-pipeline variant), milestone timeline, Markdown notes, cards.
Review: FSRS spaced repetition (ts-fsrs). Finishing a #learn task asks "What should future-you be
Progress: year heatmap, streaks with freezes, levels with DV-themed titles, charts, wins.
